## AMBIENT-002 — living inhabitants; final correction under qualification

This ancestry-preserving successor extends AMBIENT-001 #775. It targets `feature/ambient-001-20261124`; the predecessor's qualified application, evidence and Windows evaluator remain unchanged.

**Draft / HOLD for owner review.** No Ready transition, merge, default activation, model calls, training, physics-law change or actor-capacity import. #762 remains unaccepted; the ordinary host still supports eight actual logical actors.

### Delivered implementation

- 29 reusable module types, preserving the original eleven, and 16 ordinary editable personalities, preserving the original six version-1 profiles.
- Finite intentions and sequences; explicit personality effects and simulation-time drives; bounded World-aware spatial memory; actual copied material, terrain and peer observations; local recovery and social activity.
- Searchable staged editing, semantic controls, authored places and relationships, a scene profile library, individual overrides and transactional group Apply/Revert with preserved authority.
- Six substantial editable native environments alongside all five predecessor examples. The ordinary Workbench includes intent/perception/memory inspection and overlays.
- A registered 194-episode physical programme across 122 fresh Worlds, including matched baselines and ablations, adverse material/route/peer conditions, eight-actor comparisons and 30/120/300-second horizons. Six additional curiosity-only episodes and an actual-native thin-material probe remain separately identified.

### Qualification and final correction

The preceding application `a7250e15495667b2fcf564cbed1eaa8dea217c45` passed [full Linux/Windows qualification45540569052](https://github.com/techrote/cybersand/actions/runs/45540569052), including actual freshly extracted Windows execution, all 194 primary episodes, 29 Linux graphical captures and 29+29 Windows captures. Its delivered evaluator and complete original evidence remain preserved.

A separate [three-scene sustained Workbench observation45544614719](https://github.com/techrote/cybersand/actions/runs/45544614719) completed sixty simulation seconds per scene with actual rendered frames and copied decisions. It showed recognizable local social, material-interest and homeward sequences, alongside repetitive obstruction and a concrete home-rest inconsistency: a flyer accepted its authored20-cell arrival radius but exploration recharge still required16.

The minimal shared-rule correction is frozen at **`50c6df89528dc9ecdc5316d8c67abf203e192254`**, tree **`d9740be7cafb8ac7b7d6eee4a16219989745fd95`**. Only the exact enabled, positive-weight, actually selected home-rest module may supply its validated arrival radius; current copied geometry must still satisfy it. Ordinary opportunistic rest keeps16. Drive rates, profiles, scenes, materials, memory and actuators are unchanged. The old engine fails five expected checks; the correction passes648 living and895 predecessor checks locally.

[Full corrected-source campaign45552786466](https://github.com/techrote/cybersand/actions/runs/45552786466) and [Foundry-only confirmation45552888360](https://github.com/techrote/cybersand/actions/runs/45552888360) are running. No corrected evaluator is claimed qualified yet.

### Scientific limits retained

The earlier primary results show useful local ground recovery and some withdrawal benefits, but held-random/scripted ground controls often explore farther. Memory does not generally increase range; five-minute stalls, novelty-grid attention switching and social grouping counterexamples remain. All failures, negative results, independent readbacks and exact source identities are retained in the mission/specialist ledgers. Hosted software rendering establishes execution and graphical evidence, not physical Windows/NVIDIA playfeel.

The final decision packet, corrected portable ZIP identity and independent extracted-package review will be linked after these explicit gates finish. The PR remains Draft/HOLD throughout.
